messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary failures for release v3.3.1 in us-west-2; auto-rolled back to v3.3.0. See https://deploys.redwood/4290011220 :rotating_light:
Taylor M.: Copy. Any early signal on root cause?
Ivy C.: Initial logs point at the new batching heuristic in the tokenizer service — tokenization stalls on some long prompt combos, causing 503s.
Taylor M.: Ok. Plan: pin traffic to v3.3.0 and ship a tiny revert hotfix. Ops, can you do an expedited rollout (skip-canary) for a short observation window?
ops-oncall: Oncall here. We can support skip-canary for 30m. Rollback triggers needed: errors >0.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency up >200ms for 3m. Also abort if OOMs appear.
QA-bot: Running smoke suite `smoke/hotfix-v331`. One flaky failure on long-seq generator at +4m. Flagging for attention.
Ivy C.: I'll open a revert PR now: https://git.redwood/patches/5010  (revert: tokenizer/batching-heuristic). Adding smoke tests.
Taylor M.: Deploy command for ops:
```
deploybot expedite --pin v3.3.0 --patch v3.3.1-hotfix-revert --skip-canary --window 30m --owner taylor
```
deploy-bot: Expedite command received from Taylor M.. Starting controlled rollout with skip-canary. Notifying oncall and owners.
ops-oncall: Rolling at 40% - healthchecks green. Monitoring p50/p95 and error rate. Telemetry: https://metrics.redwood/r/4290011220
QA-bot: Smoke tests re-run at +8m — previously failing case now passes.
ops-oncall: Metrics stable at +15m. No rollback.
Taylor M.: Locking traffic pin to v3.3.0 for 12h and filing follow-up: https://issues.redwood/FT-4215  Owner: Ivy C.
release-coordinator: Release note published: "hotfix(revert): revert batching heuristic to address tokenizer stalls". Closing change window and moving to observation mode. :white_check_mark:
